tasks.label: ui: watch
tasks.detail: Rebuild the panel UI (vscode-extension/ui → out/ui) on save; reload a panel to see it

tasks.label: ext: install
tasks.detail: Package the extension and install it into this VS Code, so design folders work without F5

tasks.label: release: package
tasks.detail: Build dist/hitlcad-<version>/ (wheel with the UI, VS Code extension, installer) to share

tasks.label: ext: playground
tasks.detail: Create or refresh ~/hitlcad-playground (a design project) for the Extension Development Host to open

tasks.label: server: wait
tasks.detail: Wait until the debugged server answers, so the extension does not spawn its own
tasks.command: for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/health >/dev/null && exit 0; sleep 0.5; done; echo 'hitlcad server did not come up on :8000'; exit 1
